gloss: harvest moon; bright full moon (esp. of mid-autumn)

definitions.gloss: harvest moon; bright full moon, especially in mid-autumn
definitions.explanation: A particularly bright and beautiful full moon, traditionally that of the 15th night of the 8th lunar month (mid-autumn). The classic object of {月見|つきみ} (moon viewing).

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{名月|めいげつ}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: We can see the harvest moon tonight.

examples.japanese: {縁側|えんがわ}で{名月|めいげつ}を{眺|なが}めた。
examples.english: We gazed at the harvest moon from the veranda.

examples.japanese: {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}の{名月|めいげつ}を{楽|たの}しむために、{家族|かぞく}で{団子|だんご}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: To enjoy the mid-autumn harvest moon, the family prepared dumplings.

notes:
{名|めい} (renowned, fine) + {月|げつ} (moon). Specifically a moon worth celebrating, not just any full moon.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The canonical {名月|めいげつ} is the {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}の{名月|めいげつ}, the harvest moon of the 15th night of the 8th lunar month. A secondary {十三夜|じゅうさんや} ('13th night') moon a month later is also traditionally viewed. Skipping either was considered bad luck ({片見月|かたみつき}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中秋|ちゅうしゅう}の{名月|めいげつ}: the mid-autumn harvest moon
- {名月|めいげつ}を{眺|なが}める: to gaze at the harvest moon
- {名月|めいげつ}を{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy the harvest moon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {満月|まんげつ}: full moon — neutral astronomical term, any month
- {十五夜|じゅうごや}: the 15th night — the night the harvest moon is viewed
- {望月|もちづき}: full moon (literary)
